about_the_game:
In this 2d "Metroidvania" puzzle platformer you will solely equipped with The Matter Gun, a multi purpose utility that can fire a wide range of...matter...From basic blocks, to bouncy fungi-like blobs and other new types of matter that you will have to discover. Use The Matter Gun help you navigate terrain and explore and investigate this strange underground testing facility and the surrounding caves. 

Described by some as "Cave Story meets Portal." This title has been inspired by both classic and recent entries into the metroidvania/brania category and hopes to deliver a new take on what the sub-genre can be.

Enjoy hand made pixel art and synth based music and sfx. ABSOLUTELY NO AI GENERATED CONTENT.

Tinker with a dense, interconnected and mechanical 2D world full of puzzles, platforming, and secrets to uncover. What you may encounter may be odd, cryptic and challenging, luckily The Matter Gun will always be at your side.

The Matter Gun is yours to explore with, overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and seemingly break the laws of physics with. 

DISCLAIMER / SUPPORT!!!

This game is very much still underdevelopment and YOU can play a large part in guiding its development. What can you do? Whishlist and try out the Demo. If you'd like to share your findings and thoughts to help make a better game come join the Discord -> (link somewhere on this page).

Thank you.

short_description: SHOOT NOT TO KILL? use The Matter Gun to traverse this one of a kind 2d PUZZLE-platformer (metroidvania/brania). Drop into the lab, explore the caves, discover new types of matter, uncover secrets, and try not to cause the end of the world...or something.
